# Checked ordinary clash reachability

Full goal: all GMEOW logic issues/PRs and pipeline dataflow. Native issue586 implements an actual prerequisite of1803's checked-support task; it does not complete the downstream cutover. Existing501 concerns reusable forward explanation sessions, not this DL-clause witness gap. Source confirms one predecessor-linked Journal already replays prepared bound clashes; ordinary clauses currently only compare observed versus grounded facts. Root REWORK_LIST.md and sibling work remain untouched. Repository law, ring-fence, native RDF1.2, fixed proof ceilings, no new dependencies/features, no host probes/caps and normal hooks apply. Independent dispatch is unavailable; reviews must be labelled self-review.

## Task 1: One shared support arena and ordinary recording

Extend the existing Journal activation to all recorded searches and retain actual clause applications once across branches. Move immutable application links into the proof; each clash retains only its prefix cursor/frame, with the prepared bound law separate. Eliminate the old per-clash copied application vectors instead of introducing another support owner. Preserve recording-free decisions/work/counters and disclosed physical refusal/truncation. Unrecorded searches allocate no journal.

## Task 2: Replay and typed source identity

Replay the selected finite prefix from the consumer's assertions/refutation assumptions using the original licensed graph operations, never saturation/search. Validate predecessor topology, source/contract, actual bodies, deterministic/branch heads, generated nodes, equalities and final frames/witnesses. Ordinary and prepared clauses share this check. Preserve attested/trusted/unattested counts and the separate concrete-domain/merge-closure limits. Resolve a named clash node only after checked current support, preserving original TermValue/scoped blank identity. That identity is not a local contradiction authorization and cannot justify ex falso for unrelated individuals.

## Task 3: Wire grammar and adversarial qualification

Version the actual shared-arena layout. Keep existing legacy decoding honest and bounded; missing/forged support cannot acquire the new reachability claim. Use one application codec, not duplicated legacy/current algorithms. Exercise public native services; asserted/derived clashes; branches/equality/generated/anonymous/disconnected controls; wrong source and tampered cursors, frames, branch choices/heads; prepared-bound and recording-refusal regressions. Prove arena sharing rather than summing copied prefixes. Run focused tests, strict affected Clippy, complete helper check, actual WASM and normal hooks.

## Task 4: Publish and integrate

Update issue/PR with real evidence, inspect complete CodeRabbit surfaces, and merge only with ghprsq under existing pending-hosted-CI authority. Archive selected Stage evidence before owned cleanup. Continue exact GMEOW source-leaf integration and shared-store/delta/delegation; no broader completion claim is permitted from this native unit.

Record and replay ordinary DL clash support

Closes #586

## What changed

Ordinary empty-head DL clause recordings previously checked structural grounding while leaving derived premises unattested. Retain their actual licensed application paths and replay them from the consumer's assertions and selected assumptions through the native graph operations, without saturation or search. Prepared cardinality clashes share this replay path. Direct clash replay regenerates cited branch alternatives from the source clause; whole-tree replay checks the exact enclosing branch path.

One predecessor-linked arena owns applications across branches. Each clash holds a cursor/frame instead of a copied prefix. Prepared bound laws remain separate source evidence. Checked named/scoped-blank identity is resolved only after current replay and source-individual validation; it does not authorize a local contradiction or consequences for unrelated individuals. Recording preserves search decisions, counters and typed refusal/truncation.

The shared wire layout is v5. v3 unsupported premises retain explicit unattested classification and original bytes. v4 prepared prefixes decode through the same application codec and normalize into v5 within the aggregate recording ceiling. Three service proof digests intentionally change because they contain newly supported refutations; five service hashes, the legacy v3 clash digest and calculus contract stay pinned. The obsolete schema-local support counter is removed with its storage owner. Concrete-domain and merge-closure limitations stay explicit. Replay still reconstructs a graph per clash; no unmeasured batch/delta runtime gain is claimed.

Validation: full affected entailment library722 passed/1 existing ignored; final affected proof102 and arena3 passed; five public production-service cases passed natively and on actual WASM, including scoped blanks, disconnected controls, service/certificate parity, generated witnesses, fresh assumptions and nominal equality. Strict settled all-target Clippy, complete final make helpers-hygiene, normal commit and push hooks passed. The new domain registry row was generated by its owning tool. Corrected earlier test/golden/registry failures are retained in Stage rather than suppressed.

No runtime dependency, semantic feature, profile weakening, host probes, resource cap, corpus factory or local optimized GMEOW producer/gate invocation. Unrelated root work and sibling worktrees are preserved. Self-review and completion self-audit are explicit; independent review was unavailable and is not claimed. Complete review submissions, inline comments and all review threads were inspected, with zero submitted findings. CodeRabbit and hosted breadth/workspace lanes are pending, not passed. Integration proceeds under the existing instruction to ghprsq now and own subsequent CI findings.

Authoritative plan: .stage/replay-ordinary-dl-clash-reachability/plan.md. Selected Stage: .stage/replay-ordinary-dl-clash-reachability. It retains issue/plan/prior-art/self-review, acceptance index, raw test/hook logs and complete current review evidence. Broader GMEOW1803/source-leaf/shared-store/delta/delegation and the full logic backlog remain open.
